changes.page_1: Renumbered the existing 스캔 데이터 입력 현황 research tile from 08 to 07 after section 07 deletion in v37.
changes.page_5: Prepared the bundled original 38-second MP4 as a complete browser Blob URL before enabling native playback controls, allowing forward/backward seeking even on servers without HTTP 206 byte-range responses; retained native seek bar and original file.
changes.loading: Shows a simple loading label before the video is fully seekable; falls back to the original MP4 source if fetching fails.
changes.keyboard: Prevents global chapter ArrowLeft/ArrowRight shortcuts while the video element has focus.
changes.version: Updated visible version number, accessibility label and cache version for modified CSS/JS.

preserved: Page 4 dark scrollbar and rotation handle behavior
limitations: Browser tests used Chromium with real bundled MP4 bytes supplied via an intercepted response in an isolated HTML/CSS/JS runtime; full HTTP/WebGL integration was not tested.
File-protocol and HTTP deployments that block the media fetch fall back to the original MP4 and may retain the original server-specific seeking limitation.
Actual iOS/Android devices, Safari and Firefox were not tested.
